learn.pageTitle: Riichi Mahjong Fu for Sets: Sequences, Triplets, Quads
learn.pageDescription: How sets add fu in riichi mahjong: sequences, open and closed triplets, and quads, for simples and for terminals and honors, explained with tile images.
learn.whatIsMentsuFuBody: Depending on the [[mentsu|sets]] in the hand, fu are added when you [[hora|win]]. A [[shuntsu|sequence]] is always 0 fu, but a [[koutsu|triplet]] or [[kantsu|quad]] changes its fu by the kind of tile ([[chunchanpai|simples]] or [[yaochuuhai|terminals and honors]]) and by whether it is open (called) or closed (made in your own hand).
learn.shuntsuBody: A sequence is always 0 fu, whether it is open or closed.
learn.koutsuBody: A triplet changes its fu by whether it was called ([[minkou|open triplet]]) or made in your own hand ([[ankou|closed triplet]]), and by whether it is made of simples or of terminals and honors. Terminals and honors are the 1 and 9 [[shuupai|number tiles]] and the [[jihai|honor tiles]]; simples are the number tiles 2 to 8. In the examples below, the one tile turned sideways marks a call, and a triplet with that mark is an open triplet.
learn.koutsuOpenYaochuLabel: Open triplet of terminals or honors
learn.koutsuClosedYaochuLabel: Closed triplet of terminals or honors
learn.kantsuBody:
A quad is worth 4 times a triplet of the same kind of tile, open or closed in the same way. For example, an open triplet of simples is 2 fu, so an [[minkan|open quad]] of simples is 4 times that: 8 fu.
As with triplets, a [[ankan|closed quad]] is worth double an open quad, and terminals and honors are worth double simples. A closed quad is made entirely in your own hand, so the examples below show it with the tiles at both ends face down.
learn.kantsuOpenYaochuLabel: Open quad of terminals or honors
learn.kantsuClosedYaochuLabel: Closed quad of terminals or honors
learn.rowClosedSimpleKoutsuOrOpenYaochuKoutsu: Closed triplet of simples / open triplet of terminals or honors
learn.rowClosedYaochuKoutsuOrOpenSimpleKantsu: Closed triplet of terminals or honors / open quad of simples
learn.rowClosedSimpleKantsuOrOpenYaochuKantsu: Closed quad of simples / open quad of terminals or honors
learn.rowClosedYaochuKantsu: Closed quad of terminals or honors
